mapper.sql: l.id, l.student_id, l.building, l.room_no, l.occur_date, l.type, l.out_time, l.in_time, l.source, l.reason, l.reason_note, l.student_note, l.confirmed, l.confirmed_by, l.confirmed_at, l.counselor_id, l.handling, l.handling_note, l.violation_id, l.created_at, l.updated_at, l.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, p.student_no AS student_no, p.class_name AS class_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.real_name, ''), cs.nickname, cs.username) AS counselor_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(cb.real_name, ''), cb.nickname, cb.username) AS confirmed_by_name

FROM community_late l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.student_id LEFT JOIN student_profile p ON p.user_id = l.student_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users cs ON cs.id = l.counselor_id LEFT JOIN users cb ON cb.id = l.confirmed_by

sql.if: AND (l.reason_note LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.building LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.room_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_late (student_id, building, room_no, occur_date, type, out_time, in_time, source, reason, reason_note, student_note, confirmed, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, counselor_id, handling, handling_note, violation_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{building}, #{roomNo}, #{occurDate}, #{type}, #{outTime}, #{inTime}, #{source}, #{reason}, #{reasonNote}, #{studentNote}, #{confirmed}, #{confirmedBy}, #{confirmedAt}, #{counselorId}, #{handling}, #{handlingNote}, #{violationId}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE l.student_id = #{studentId} AND l.occur_date = #{occurDate} AND l.type = #{type} AND l.deleted = 0 ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE community_late SET building = #{late.building}, room_no = #{late.roomNo}, occur_date = #{late.occurDate}, type = #{late.type}, out_time = #{late.outTime}, in_time = #{late.inTime}, source = #{late.source}, reason = #{late.reason}, reason_note = #{late.reasonNote}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{late.id} AND deleted = 0 AND handling = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE community_late SET confirmed = 1, confirmed_by = #{by}, confirmed_at = #{at}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND confirmed = 0
UPDATE community_late SET handling = #{handling}, handling_note = #{handlingNote}, violation_id = #{violationId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND handling = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE community_late SET student_note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE community_late SET violation_id = #{violationId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND violation_id IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT l.type AS type, COUNT(*) AS total FROM community_late l WHERE l.deleted = 0
GROUP BY l.type ORDER BY l.type

SELECT l.handling AS handling, COUNT(*) AS total FROM community_late l WHERE l.deleted = 0
GROUP BY l.handling ORDER BY l.handling

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN l.type = 'late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.type = 'absent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absent_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.confirmed = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unconfirmed, SUM(CASE WHEN l.handling = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN l.handling = 'contacted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contacted, SUM(CASE WHEN l.handling = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed FROM community_late l WHERE l.deleted = 0
